# Which of your Python dependencies lack a provenance attestation?

> Paste a requirements.txt or pyproject.toml to see which Python dependencies have PyPI provenance attestations and which rely on classic API tokens.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [This checker vs. Socket](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/pypi-provenance-check/vs-socket.html)
